from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# ============================================================
# 1. READ FROM DELTA
# ============================================================
STORAGE_ACCOUNT  = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER        = "malta"                          # ← Update for MFT
DELTA_MOVES_PATH = "silver/moves"
OUTPUT_PATH      = "gold/tranship_pairs"


BASE_PATH    = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
MOVES_PATH   = f"{BASE_PATH}/{DELTA_MOVES_PATH}"
OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{OUTPUT_PATH}"


df = spark.read.format("delta").load(MOVES_PATH)

# ============================================================
# 2. FILTER TRANSHIPMENT ONLY
# ============================================================
df_trshp = df.filter(
    (F.col("Category_Id") == "TRSHP") &
    (F.col("Event_Type_Id").isin("UNIT_DISCH", "UNIT_LOAD")) &
    (F.col("Year") >= 2026)
)

# ============================================================
# 3. EXTRACT YARDBLOCK FROM POSITION NAME
# Format: Y-MFT-XE 040 06B → XE
# ============================================================
def extract_yardblock(col_name):
    return F.when(
        F.col(col_name).startswith("Y-"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col(col_name), r"^Y-[^-]+-([^ ]+)", 1)
    ).otherwise(F.lit(None))

df_trshp = df_trshp \
    .withColumn("From_YardBlock", extract_yardblock("From_Position_Name")) \
    .withColumn("To_YardBlock",   extract_yardblock("To_Position_Name"))

# ============================================================
# 4. CRANE LOOKUP
# ============================================================
cranes_data = [
    ("PQC34","T1"),("PQC33","T1"),("PQC32","T1"),("PQC31","T1"),
    ("PQC30","T1"),("PQC29","T2"),("PQC28","T2"),("QC07", "T2"),
    ("QC08", "T2"),("QC02", "T1"),("QC01", "T1"),("QC23", "T1"),
    ("QC20", "T1"),("QC33", "T1"),("QC34", "T1"),("QC30", "T1"),
    ("QC31", "T1"),("QC32", "T1"),("PQC27","T2"),("PQC26","T2"),
    ("PQC25","T2"),("PQC23","T1"),("PQC21","T1"),("PQC20","T1"),
    ("PQC08","T2"),("PQC07","T2"),("PQC06","T2"),("PQC05","T2"),
    ("PQC04","T2"),("PQC03","T2"),("PQC02","T1"),("PQC01","T1"),
    ("QR01", "T1"),("QC25", "T2"),("QC26", "T2"),("QC29", "T2"),
    ("QC27", "T2"),("QC28", "T2"),("QC03", "T2"),("QC04", "T2"),
    ("QC05", "T2"),("QC06", "T2")
]
df_cranes = spark.createDataFrame(cranes_data, ["CraneId", "Crane_Terminal"])

# ============================================================
# 5. YARDBLOCK LOOKUP
# ============================================================
yardblocks_data = [
    ("1A","T1"),("1B","T1"),("1C","T1"),("1D","T1"),("1E","T1"),
    ("1F","T1"),("1G","T1"),("1H","T1"),("1J","T1"),("1Q","T2"),
    ("1R","T1"),("1S","T2"),("1T","T2"),("1V","T2"),("1Y","T2"),
    ("1Z","T2"),("2A","T1"),("2B","T1"),("2C","T1"),("2D","T1"),
    ("2E","T1"),("2F","T1"),("2G","T1"),("2H","T1"),("2J","T1"),
    ("2L","T2"),("2R","T1"),("2S","T2"),("2N","T1"),("3A","T1"),
    ("3B","T1"),("3C","T1"),("3D","T1"),("3E","T1"),("3F","T1"),
    ("3L","T2"),("3M","T2"),("3N","T1"),("3P","T2"),("3Q","T2"),
    ("3R","T1"),("3S","T2"),("3T","T2"),("3V","T2"),("3Y","T2"),
    ("3Z","T2"),("4A","T1"),("4B","T1"),("4C","T1"),("4N","T2"),
    ("5N","T2"),("CZ","T2"),("GD","T1"),("GE","T1"),("GF","T1"),
    ("KD","T2"),("SC","T1"),("WA","T1"),("WB","T1"),("WC","T2"),
    ("WE","T2"),("XA","T1"),("XB","T1"),("XC","T1"),("XD","T1"),
    ("XE","T1"),("XF","T1"),("XG","T1"),("XH","T1"),("XJ","T1"),
    ("XK","T1"),("XL","T1"),("XM","T1"),("XR","T1"),("PA","T1"),
    ("1N","T1"),("ONS","T1"),("BR","T1")
]
df_yardblocks = spark.createDataFrame(yardblocks_data, ["YardBlock", "TerminalShort"])

# ============================================================
# 6. JOIN TERMINAL LOOKUPS
# ============================================================
df_enriched = df_trshp \
    .join(df_cranes,    df_trshp.pow            == df_cranes.CraneId,      "left") \
    .join(df_yardblocks.alias("yf"), 
          df_trshp.From_YardBlock == F.col("yf.YardBlock"), "left") \
    .withColumnRenamed("TerminalShort", "From_Terminal") \
    .join(df_yardblocks.alias("yt"), 
          df_trshp.To_YardBlock   == F.col("yt.YardBlock"), "left") \
    .withColumnRenamed("TerminalShort", "To_Terminal")

# ============================================================
# 7. SEQUENCE MOVES PER UNIT
# ============================================================
window_seq = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("t_put")

df_sequenced = df_enriched.withColumn("move_seq", F.row_number().over(window_seq))

# ============================================================
# 8. SPLIT INTO DISCH AND LOAD
# ============================================================
df_disch = df_sequenced.filter(F.col("Event_Type_Id") == "UNIT_DISCH") \
    .select(
        "Unit_Nbr", "mve_gkey", "move_seq",
        "t_put", "Carrier_Visit_Key",
        "Crane_Terminal", "To_Terminal", "To_YardBlock",
        "Freight_Kind_Id"
    )

df_load = df_sequenced.filter(F.col("Event_Type_Id") == "UNIT_LOAD") \
    .select(
        "Unit_Nbr",
        F.col("mve_gkey").alias("load_mve_gkey"),
        F.col("move_seq").alias("load_move_seq"),
        F.col("t_put").alias("load_datetime"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("load_vessel"),
        F.col("Crane_Terminal").alias("load_crane_terminal"),
        F.col("From_Terminal").alias("load_yard_terminal"),
        F.col("From_YardBlock").alias("load_yard_block")
    )

# ============================================================
# 9. PAIR DISCH → NEXT LOAD (using window lead instead of 
#    correlated subquery — much faster!)
# ============================================================
window_unit = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("move_seq")

# Add next load info directly onto disch rows using a join + window
df_joined = df_disch.join(df_load, on="Unit_Nbr", how="inner") \
    .filter(F.col("load_move_seq") > F.col("move_seq"))

# Keep only the CLOSEST next load per discharge
window_closest = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr", "mve_gkey").orderBy("load_move_seq")

df_paired = df_joined \
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(window_closest)) \
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1) \
    .drop("rn", "load_move_seq", "move_seq")

# ============================================================
# 10. ADD DERIVED COLUMNS
# ============================================================
window_tranship = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("t_put")

df_final = df_paired \
    .withColumn("dwell_hours", 
        (F.col("load_datetime").cast("long") - 
         F.col("t_put").cast("long")) / 3600
    ) \
    .withColumn("tranship_sequence", 
        F.row_number().over(window_tranship)
    ) \
    .withColumn("tranship_type",
        F.when(
            F.col("Crane_Terminal") != F.col("load_crane_terminal"),
            F.lit("Cross-Terminal")
        ).otherwise(F.lit("Same-Terminal"))
    ) \
    .withColumn("terminal_flow",
        F.concat(F.col("Crane_Terminal"), F.lit(" to "), F.col("load_crane_terminal"))
    ) \
    .withColumn("disch_date",  F.to_date("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("load_date",   F.to_date("load_datetime")) \
    .withColumn("disch_year",  F.year("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("disch_month", F.month("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("disch_month_name", F.date_format("t_put", "MMMM")) \
    .withColumn("disch_year_month", F.date_format("t_put", "yyyy-MM")) \
    .withColumnRenamed("t_put", "disch_datetime") \
    .withColumnRenamed("Carrier_Visit_Key", "disch_vessel") \
    .withColumnRenamed("Crane_Terminal", "disch_crane_terminal") \
    .withColumnRenamed("To_Terminal", "disch_yard_terminal") \
    .withColumnRenamed("To_YardBlock", "disch_yard_block")

# ============================================================
# 11. WRITE TO DELTA (silver layer)
# ============================================================
# df_final.cache()
# print(f"Total pairs: {df_final.count()}")
# df_final.show()

df_final.write \
    .format("delta") \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .save(OUTPUT_DELTA)

print("✅ tranship_pairs written successfully!")
# print(f"Total pairs: {df_final.count()}")
